summary: Postinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: @kibt/www-nuxt-i18n@0.1.0 ships beacon.cjs, which collects the installer's hostname, install path, cwd, Node version, and OS details and POSTs them to the hardcoded bare-IP HTTP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The beacon fires automatically via package.json scripts.postinstall (`node beacon.cjs`) on `npm install`, and also runs on `require()` because index.js invokes `require('./beacon.cjs').fire()`. The destination is a plain-HTTP bare-IP collector unrelated to any documented publisher infrastructure, and the package itself exposes no library functionality consistent with the `@kibt/www-nuxt-i18n` name — only the beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
